description: List bridges in one county (state + 3-digit FIPS county code), paged. Read-only lookup of the FHWA NBI 2025 annual snapshot; no API key. Results are decoded records ordered by state, county code, then structure number. limit defaults to 100 (max 1000); offset defaults to 0, pass offset in multiples of limit to page. Use search_bridges instead for filtered queries across counties, and get_county_summaries instead for county counts rather than individual bridges.

offset.description: Results to skip for paging, default 0

name: list_bridges_in_county
